content: लास्यम् [लस्-ण्यत्] .²1 Dancing; a dance; आस्ये धास्यति कस्य लास्यमधुना … वाचां विपाको मम <ls>Bv. 4. 42</ls>; <ls>R. 16. 14</ls>. .²2 A dance accompanied with singing and instrumental music. .²3 A dance in which the emotions of love are represented by means of various gesticulations and attitudes; अरुणाधरकिरणबालकिसलयलास्यहेतुभिः <ls>Dk. 2. 5</ls>. .{@-स्यः@} A dancer, an actor. .{@-स्या@} A dancing girl.
